NKJV.2: “I have heard many such things; Miserable comforters are you all!
NKJV.3: Shall words of wind have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
NKJV.4: I also could speak as you do, If your soul were in my soul’s place. I could heap up words against you, And shake my head at you;
NKJV.5: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, And the comfort of my lips would relieve your grief.
NKJV.6: “Though I speak, my grief is not relieved; And if I remain silent, how am I eased?
NKJV.7: But now He has worn me out; You have made desolate all my company.
NKJV.8: You have shriveled me up, And it is a witness against me; My leanness rises up against me And bears witness to my face.
NKJV.9: He tears me in His wrath, and hates me; He gnashes at me with His teeth; My adversary sharpens His gaze on me.
NKJV.10: They gape at me with their mouth, They strike me reproachfully on the cheek, They gather together against me.
NKJV.11: God has delivered me to the ungodly, And turned me over to the hands of the wicked.
NKJV.12: I was at ease, but He has shattered me; He also has taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces; He has set me up for His target,
NKJV.13: His archers surround me. He pierces my heart and does not pity; He pours out my gall on the ground.
NKJV.14: He breaks me with wound upon wound; He runs at me like a warrior.
NKJV.15: “I have sewn sackcloth over my skin, And laid my head in the dust.
NKJV.16: My face is flushed from weeping, And on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
NKJV.17: Although no violence is in my hands, And my prayer is pure.
NKJV.18: “O earth, do not cover my blood, And let my cry have no resting place!
NKJV.19: Surely even now my witness is in heaven, And my evidence is on high.
NKJV.20: My friends scorn me; My eyes pour out tears to God.
NKJV.21: Oh, that one might plead for a man with God, As a man pleads for his neighbor!
NKJV.22: For when a few years are finished, I shall go the way of no return.

AMP.2:
"I have heard many such things;
Wearisome and miserable comforters are you all.
AMP.3:
"Is there no end to [your futile] words of wind?
Or what plagues you [so much] that you [so boldly] answer [me like this]?
AMP.4:
"I also could speak like you,
If you were in my place;
I could compose and join words together against you
And shake my head at you.
AMP.5:
"[But instead] I could strengthen and encourage you with [the words of] my mouth,
And the consolation and solace of my lips would soothe your suffering and lessen your anguish.
AMP.6:
"If I speak [to you miserable comforters], my pain is not relieved;
And if I refrain [from speaking], what [pain or anguish] leaves me?
AMP.7:
"But now God has exhausted me.
You [O Lord] have destroyed all my family and my household.
AMP.8:
"You have taken a firm hold on me and have shriveled me up,
It has become a witness [against me];
And my leanness [and infirmity] rises up [as evidence] against me,
It testifies to my face [about my guilt].
AMP.9:
"His wrath has torn me and hunted me down,
He has gnashed at me with his teeth;
My adversary sharpens His gaze and glares [with piercing eyes] at me.
AMP.10:
"They have gaped at me with their mouths,
With contempt they have struck me on the cheek;
They massed themselves together [and conspired] against me.
AMP.11:
"God hands me over to criminals
And tosses me [headlong] into the hands of the wicked.
AMP.12:
"I was [living] at ease, but He crushed me and broke me apart,
And He has seized me by the neck and has shaken me to pieces;
He has also set me up as His target.
AMP.13:
"His arrows surround me.
He pierces my kidneys (vital organs) without mercy;
He pours out my gall on the ground.
AMP.14:
"He attacks me, making wound after wound;
He runs at me like a warrior.
AMP.15:
"I have sewed sackcloth over my skin [as a sign of mourning]
And have defiled my horn (symbol of strength) in the dust.
AMP.16:
"My face is red and swollen with weeping,
And on my eyelids is the shadow of death [my eyes are dimmed],
AMP.17:
Although there is no violence or wrongdoing in my hands,
And my prayer is pure.
AMP.18:
"O earth, do not cover my blood,
And let there be no [resting] place for my cry [where it will cease being heard].
AMP.19:
"Even now, behold, my Witness is in heaven,
And my Advocate [who vouches and testifies for me] is on high.
AMP.20:
"My friends are scoffers [who ridicule];
My eye pours out tears to God.
AMP.21:
"Oh, that a man would mediate and plead with God [for me]
Just as a man [mediates and pleads] with his neighbor and friend.
AMP.22:
"For when a few years are past,
I shall go the way of no return.

NLT.2:
“I have heard all this before.
What miserable comforters you are!
NLT.3:
Won’t you ever stop blowing hot air?
What makes you keep on talking?
NLT.4:
I could say the same things if you were in my place.
I could spout off criticism and shake my head at you.
NLT.5:
But if it were me, I would encourage you.
I would try to take away your grief.
NLT.6:
Instead, I suffer if I defend myself,
and I suffer no less if I refuse to speak.
NLT.7:
“O God, you have ground me down
and devastated my family.
NLT.8:
As if to prove I have sinned, you’ve reduced me to skin and bones.
My gaunt flesh testifies against me.
NLT.9:
God hates me and angrily tears me apart.
He snaps his teeth at me
and pierces me with his eyes.
NLT.10:
People jeer and laugh at me.
They slap my cheek in contempt.
A mob gathers against me.
NLT.11:
God has handed me over to sinners.
He has tossed me into the hands of the wicked.
NLT.12:
“I was living quietly until he shattered me.
He took me by the neck and broke me in pieces.
Then he set me up as his target,
NLT.13:
and now his archers surround me.
His arrows pierce me without mercy.
The ground is wet with my blood.
NLT.14:
Again and again he smashes against me,
charging at me like a warrior.
NLT.15:
I wear burlap to show my grief.
My pride lies in the dust.
NLT.16:
My eyes are red with weeping;
dark shadows circle my eyes.
NLT.17:
Yet I have done no wrong,
and my prayer is pure.
NLT.18:
“O earth, do not conceal my blood.
Let it cry out on my behalf.
NLT.19:
Even now my witness is in heaven.
My advocate is there on high.
NLT.20:
My friends scorn me,
but I pour out my tears to God.
NLT.21:
I need someone to mediate between God and me,
as a person mediates between friends.
NLT.22:
For soon I must go down that road
from which I will never return.

MSG.2:
"I've had all I can take of your talk.
What a bunch of miserable comforters!
MSG.3:
Is there no end to your windbag speeches?
What's your problem that you go on and on like this?
MSG.4:
If you were in my shoes,
I could talk just like you.
I could put together a terrific harangue
and really let you have it.
MSG.5:
But I'd never do that. I'd console and comfort,
make things better, not worse!
MSG.6:
"When I speak up, I feel no better;
if I say nothing, that doesn't help either.
MSG.7:
I feel worn down.
God, you have wasted me totally—me and my family!
MSG.8:
You've shriveled me like a dried prune,
showing the world that you're against me.
My gaunt face stares back at me from the mirror,
a mute witness to your treatment of me.
MSG.9:
Your anger tears at me,
your teeth rip me to shreds,
your eyes burn holes in me—God, my enemy!
MSG.10:
People take one look at me and gasp.
Contemptuous, they slap me around
and gang up against me.
MSG.11:
And God just stands there and lets them do it,
lets wicked people do what they want with me.
MSG.12:
I was contentedly minding my business when God beat me up.
He grabbed me by the neck and threw me around.
He set me up as his target,
MSG.13:
then rounded up archers to shoot at me.
Merciless, they shot me full of arrows;
bitter bile poured from my gut to the ground.
MSG.14:
He burst in on me, onslaught after onslaught,
charging me like a mad bull.
MSG.15:
"I sewed myself a shroud and wore it like a shirt;
I lay face down in the dirt.
MSG.16:
Now my face is blotched red from weeping;
look at the dark shadows under my eyes,
MSG.17:
Even though I've never hurt a soul
and my prayers are sincere!
MSG.18:
"O Earth, don't cover up the wrong done to me!
Don't muffle my cry!
MSG.19:
There must be Someone in heaven who knows the truth about me,
in highest heaven, some Attorney who can clear my name—
MSG.20:
My Champion, my Friend,
while I'm weeping my eyes out before God.
MSG.21:
I appeal to the One who represents mortals before God
as a neighbor stands up for a neighbor.
MSG.22:
"Only a few years are left
before I set out on the road of no return.

NRSVCE.2:
“I have heard many such things;
miserable comforters are you all.
NRSVCE.3:
Have windy words no limit?
Or what provokes you that you keep on talking?
NRSVCE.4:
I also could talk as you do,
if you were in my place;
I could join words together against you,
and shake my head at you.
NRSVCE.5:
I could encourage you with my mouth,
and the solace of my lips would assuage your pain.
NRSVCE.6:
“If I speak, my pain is not assuaged,
and if I forbear, how much of it leaves me?
NRSVCE.7:
Surely now God has worn me out;
he has made desolate all my company.
NRSVCE.8:
And he has shriveled me up,
which is a witness against me;
my leanness has risen up against me,
and it testifies to my face.
NRSVCE.9:
He has torn me in his wrath, and hated me;
he has gnashed his teeth at me;
my adversary sharpens his eyes against me.
NRSVCE.10:
They have gaped at me with their mouths;
they have struck me insolently on the cheek;
they mass themselves together against me.
NRSVCE.11:
God gives me up to the ungodly,
and casts me into the hands of the wicked.
NRSVCE.12:
I was at ease, and he broke me in two;
he seized me by the neck and dashed me to pieces;
he set me up as his target;
NRSVCE.13:
his archers surround me.
He slashes open my kidneys, and shows no mercy;
he pours out my gall on the ground.
NRSVCE.14:
He bursts upon me again and again;
he rushes at me like a warrior.
NRSVCE.15:
I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin,
and have laid my strength in the dust.
NRSVCE.16:
My face is red with weeping,
and deep darkness is on my eyelids,
NRSVCE.17:
though there is no violence in my hands,
and my prayer is pure.
NRSVCE.18:
“O earth, do not cover my blood;
let my outcry find no resting place.
NRSVCE.19:
Even now, in fact, my witness is in heaven,
and he that vouches for me is on high.
NRSVCE.20:
My friends scorn me;
my eye pours out tears to God,
NRSVCE.21:
that he would maintain the right of a mortal with God,
as one does for a neighbor.
NRSVCE.22:
For when a few years have come,
I shall go the way from which I shall not return.
